symptom: Removing the last MCP server left the removed entry's width as spaces inside `servers = [ ]`, so every add and remove cycle grew settings.toml. toml-patch 2.0.0 kept that padding; 3.0.2 and later write `servers = []`.
rule: Give a writer bug a direct writer test whose first assertion is the bad output, so the replay fails at the parent on this bug rather than on another one the same PR fixes (the add and remove cycle test stops at the old false edit conflict first). Look for the fix in newer releases of a misbehaving library before working around it (principle 13).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/settings/__tests__/files.test.ts -t 'empty servers array without padding'
